proposedRule.action: Independent read-only check of D3 current pointer and exact collateral ABI; no state-changing D3 Risk setter
proposedRule.requiredReadback: D3.riskModule()==0xc0f019005a25524a34F2Ee8839DCDCC50715DD7B; baseCollateralToken=mUSDC; collateralConfigs(mUSDC)=(10000,true); D3 owner=Timelock; Vault and Oracle identities unchanged; explicit D3 token config approved; D4 riskModule()==D5; D4/D6 maintenance intact
proposedRule.downstream: C13 depends on D3_TOKEN and D3_RISK_COMPAT_VERIFIED; C13 remains a separately reviewed Safe/Timelock operation

unchangedBoundaries: D3_TOKEN requires separate economic approval and public postflight
C13 must retain Safe 2/3 and custom Timelock delay
D4 stays on D5 for perp risk
D4/D6 maintenance remains until separate authorization
rationale: The deployed D3 constructor selected the legacy collateral RiskModule, whose getter ABI matches D3. D5 lacks collateralConfigs(address), so the old D3_RISK state target is unsafe.
operatorDecision: Approve or reject this exact dependency correction in a separate governance-policy decision. Technical PASS is not policy approval.
